Container.Name: grid
Container.Overview: Grid: a jobsite app for Australian trades. Sites and jobs, photos and notes, plans, quotes with online signing, on your own server. Needs the grid-postgres container (unraid/grid-postgres.xml) on the same "grid" Docker network. Open the WebUI and create the first account; it becomes the server admin.
Container.Requires: The grid-postgres container (template in the same folder), on a Docker network called "grid": run "docker network create grid" once in the Unraid terminal.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: The port you open Grid on, e.g. http://tower.local:3000

Config.Name: Files (photos, plans)
Config.Description: Photos, plans, signed quotes and other uploads. An array share is fine. Back it up together with the database.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Grid's own settings, including secrets.env (made on first start). Back this up: without it, saved passwords for email and other connections can't be read.

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Where Grid's own backups go (schedule and history in Settings > Backups). Ideally a different disk or pool from the files share.

Config.Name: Database host
Config.Description: The Postgres container's name (both on the "grid" network), or its IP address.

Config.Name: Database password
Config.Description: The same password you gave the grid-postgres container (POSTGRES_PASSWORD).

Config.Name: Address people use (BETTER_AUTH_URL)
Config.Description: Exactly how people open Grid, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:3000 (your Unraid IP and the port above) or https://grid.example.com.au. Sign-in only works from this address (add others under Other addresses).

Config.Name: Time zone (TZ)
Config.Description: For the nightly clean-up and backups, and dates in logs. Unraid passes its own time zone too; this overrides it.

Config.Name: Sign-up
Config.Description: invite: only the first account can sign up; everyone else joins through an invite from a business. open: anyone who can reach the server can make an account.

Config.Name: Other addresses (TRUSTED_ORIGINS)
Config.Description: Other addresses Grid is opened at, comma-separated, e.g. http://tower.local:3000,https://grid.example.com.au

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User Grid runs as and owns its files as. Unraid: 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group Grid runs as. Unraid: 100 (users).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Permissions for new files. 022 = others can read; 002 = the users group can also write.

Config.Name: Database port
Config.Description: Postgres port.

Config.Name: Database user
Config.Description: Same as POSTGRES_USER on grid-postgres.

Config.Name: Database name
Config.Description: Same as POSTGRES_DB on grid-postgres.

Config.Name: Database URL (overrides the above)
Config.Description: Leave blank. Only for a Postgres set up some other way: postgresql://user:password@host:5432/db

Config.Name: Apply database updates on start
Config.Description: Updates the database to match a new Grid version each time the container starts. Leave on.

Config.Name: Sign-in secret (BETTER_AUTH_SECRET)
Config.Description: Leave blank: Grid makes one and keeps it in appdata/secrets.env. Changing it signs everyone out.

Config.Name: Encryption key (APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY)
Config.Description: Leave blank: Grid makes one and keeps it in appdata/secrets.env. Never change it once set, or saved passwords (email etc.) can't be read.

Config.Name: Short link address (PUBLIC_LINK_BASE)
Config.Description: The address customers and QR codes use: quote links (/q/...), the signed-PDF check (/verify/...) and /go links. Must be reachable from the internet for customers to sign quotes online. Blank = the address above.

Config.Name: Server code prefix (INSTANCE_ID)
Config.Description: Leave blank. Set once this server joins the Grid hub (later).

Config.Name: Scheduled jobs
Config.Description: Nightly clean-up and backups run in this container. Turn off only on a second Grid container.
